title: Stackable Armor and Tools
description: A simple mod that lets you stack armor and tools including swords up to 16 items.
body:
Simple lightweight Forge 1.20.1 server-friendly mod that allows clean, unused armor, weapons, and tools to stack up to 16. It helps reduce inventory clutter from farms, loot, mob drops, and storage systems while keeping damaged, enchanted, renamed, or modified items safely unstackable.




![Clear example on how the mod works.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3bfa544c7b17f170626ca1b48922633f30169bdb.jpeg)
